## Rule

ARC-GEN `task_aedd82e4.py`: input grids are 3×3 through 5×5, with only colors 0 and 2. Recolor every color-2 cell with no orthogonal color-2 neighbor to color 1; all other cells pass through unchanged. The generator implements this as `common.edgefree_pixels(grid)` after placing red/color-2 pixels.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
out = copy(input)
for r, c in cells:
    if input[r][c] == 2 and no 4-neighbor has value 2:
        out[r][c] = 1
```

## Cost analysis

Current LIVE cost is 1,317: memory=1,250 + params=67. The graph slices ch0/ch1/ch2 to 5×5, casts to F16, counts color-2 4-neighbors, builds an isolated mask, concatenates a 10-channel 5×5 decoded tensor, then pads to the full output.

Staged v1 cost is 460: memory=0 + params=460. The only node is the graph-output Conv, so the output tensor is uncharged (#67). With `group=2`, output channels 0-4 read input channels 0-4, which is enough for all live logic:
- ch0 margin: `center_ch0`
- ch1 isolated margin: `center_ch2 - neighbor_ch2_sum`
- ch2 non-isolated margin: `7*center_ch2 + 2*neighbor_ch2_sum - 8`

Margins are exact over the generator domain. For ch2, red with one neighbor gives `+1`; isolated red gives `-1`; center-not-red with four red neighbors gives `0`, which decodes false because the official decoder uses `> 0`.

## Don't-do log

- **crop-to-5x5** (2026-05-19): SKIP — false positive. Advisory -35000 estimate wrong. Scoring skips tensors named 'input'/'output'. Model already processes at 5×5 via 3 Slice ops then Conv+Pad. Crop adds 'input_cropped'[1,10,5,5]=1000B overhead. Proven via task073 test (cost 1411→2423).

## Floor proof

Best candidate is the params-only final Conv family at 460. Direct dense ungrouped `Conv(input)->output` costs `10*10*3*3 + 10 = 910`; `group=2` is the cheapest legal grouping because ch0/ch1/ch2 outputs must all read input ch2/ch0 in the same fixed channel partition. `group=5` and `group=10` cannot make output ch1 see input ch2. The ch2 non-isolated predicate needs a threshold; without a Conv bias, padding/background cells adjacent to red cannot be separated from true red-with-neighbor cases, and Conv bias is charged as the full 10-element vector. Thus the direct grouped Conv floor for this formulation is 450+10=460.

Final-op family kill numbers: Equal-tail/color-index starts with the fixed full-canvas 900B label plane plus extraction glue (#81), already worse than 460. Where-as-output substitution also needs at least a full 30×30 condition plane (900B) before replacement constants/input passthrough. Small decoded-one-hot Pad tails pay at least a charged `[1,10,5,5]` pre-output tensor (500B F16 or 1000B F32) before any rule logic/params. QLinearConv-as-output keeps the same weight surface and adds mandatory scale/zp inputs or a charged quantization path from F32 input, so it cannot undercut 460 here. OneHot final needs a charged index plane or the same local predicate work before output. Broadcast/Add/BitwiseAnd/contraction finals cannot express 3×3 local singleton detection without first materializing a local-neighbor feature; the cheapest such materialization is already no better than making the local detector the free output Conv. Sparse Conv weights are rejected by the official scorer path per `core.md`.
